picks.name: The Procter & Gamble Company
picks.thesis: Lower-volatility business candidate to research further, not a safe asset or a 1–2 year return guarantee. P&G's Q1 FY2027 net sales rose 4% and diluted EPS rose 1%; FY27 organic sales guidance remains 1–3%.
picks.bear_case: Slow growth, commodity and foreign-exchange costs, competition or weaker consumer demand could pressure results and the share price. The latest release cited about $1.4B after-tax commodity cost headwinds.
catalysts: Review the next quarterly results and FY2027 guidance.
picks.sentiment_reason: Not scored: current-plan Twelve Data statistics and valuation metrics were unavailable; no sentiment feed evidence used.

picks.name: Johnson & Johnson
picks.thesis: Healthcare business candidate for the steadier part of a watchlist. Q3 2026 sales grew 5.9%, and the company raised its full-year guidance.
picks.bear_case: Adjusted EPS declined 7.5% year over year in Q3. Litigation, patent expirations, clinical results, regulation and competition can hurt earnings or valuation.
catalysts: Review the next quarterly report and updated full-year outlook.

picks.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

picks.name: NVIDIA Corporation
